1. Information We Collect

  • Account Data: email address, name (if provided), and authentication identifiers from third-party login providers (e.g., Google, Telegram).
  • Usage Data: IP address, browser type and version, device information, operating system, referring URLs, pages visited, feature usage, activity logs, and timestamps.
  • Payment and Subscription Data: transaction status, payment identifiers, subscription plan, billing period, and renewal status. GoToFlow does not store full credit or debit card details.
  • Content Data: prompts, topics, links, uploaded materials, and AI-generated outputs that you create or provide while using the Service.
  • Communication Data: messages, support requests, feedback, and any other correspondence you send to us.

2. How We Use Your Data

  • Provide, operate, and maintain the Service and its features.
  • Create and manage your account, subscriptions, and token balances.
  • Process payments and manage billing.
  • Provide customer support and respond to inquiries.
  • Process your prompts, links, and uploaded materials through AI systems to generate content and deliver the Service's core functionality.
  • Monitor, detect, and prevent fraud, abuse, and unauthorized access.
  • Analyze usage patterns to improve product performance, reliability, and user experience.
  • Comply with applicable legal obligations.
  • Send transactional and service-related messages (e.g., account notifications, security alerts).
  • Send marketing communications where you have given consent or where otherwise permitted by applicable law. You may opt out at any time.

3. Legal Basis for Processing

  • Performance of a contract: processing necessary to provide the Service you have signed up for.
  • Legitimate interests: improving the Service, preventing fraud, ensuring security, and conducting analytics, where these interests are not overridden by your rights.
  • Consent: where you have given explicit consent, such as for marketing communications or optional data processing.
  • Legal obligations: where processing is required to comply with applicable laws or regulations.

4. AI and Content Processing

  • To provide AI-powered features, we process the prompts, topics, links, uploaded materials, and other inputs you provide through the Service.
  • This content may be sent to third-party AI infrastructure providers for the purpose of generating outputs.
  • We process this content to provide and improve the Service where permitted by applicable law and our agreements with providers.
  • AI-generated outputs may be inaccurate, incomplete, or unsuitable for specific purposes. You are responsible for reviewing all generated content before use.

5. Cookies and Analytics

  • We use cookies and similar technologies on the Service. These include:
  • Necessary cookies: required for the basic operation of the Service (e.g., authentication, session management).
  • Analytics and performance cookies: used to understand how visitors interact with the Service, measure traffic, and identify areas for improvement.
  • Preference cookies: used to remember your settings and preferences (e.g., language selection).
  • You can manage or disable cookies through your browser settings. Disabling certain cookies may affect the functionality of the Service.

6. Data Sharing and Third Parties

  • We may share your data with the following categories of third-party providers, solely as necessary to operate and improve the Service:
  • Payment processors: to process transactions and manage subscriptions.
  • Hosting and cloud infrastructure providers: to store data and run the Service.
  • AI infrastructure providers: to process prompts and generate content.
  • Analytics tools: to measure usage and improve the product.
  • Authentication providers: to enable third-party login (e.g., Google, Telegram).
  • Support tools: to manage customer communications.
  • Legal or governmental authorities: where required by applicable law, regulation, or valid legal process.
  • We do not sell your personal data to third parties.

7. International Transfers

  • Your personal data may be transferred to and processed in countries other than your country of residence, including countries that may have different data protection standards.
  • Where such transfers occur, we apply appropriate safeguards as required by applicable law to protect your data.

8. Data Retention

  • We retain your personal data only as long as reasonably necessary for the following purposes:
  • For as long as your account remains active and you continue to use the Service.
  • As necessary to fulfill the purposes described in this Privacy Policy.
  • As required for legal, accounting, security, or dispute resolution purposes.
  • When your data is no longer needed, we will delete or anonymize it in accordance with our internal retention practices.

9. Your Rights

  • Depending on your jurisdiction, you may have the right to:
  • Access the personal data we hold about you.
  • Correct inaccurate or incomplete data.
  • Request deletion of your data, subject to legal retention requirements.
  • Restrict or object to certain processing activities.
  • Request data portability where technically feasible and required by applicable law.
  • Withdraw consent at any time, without affecting the lawfulness of processing carried out before withdrawal.
  • To exercise any of these rights, contact us at: gotoflow.io@gmail.com. We will respond within a reasonable timeframe as required by applicable law.

10. Children's Privacy

  • The Service is not intended for children under the age of 13 (or a higher age where required by local law).
  • We do not knowingly collect personal data from children. If we become aware that we have collected data from a child without appropriate consent, we will take steps to delete it.

11. Security

  • We implement reasonable technical and organizational measures to protect your personal data against unauthorized access, alteration, disclosure, or destruction.
  • No method of transmission over the Internet or electronic storage is completely secure. While we strive to protect your data, we cannot guarantee absolute security.

12. Changes to This Policy

  • We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time to reflect changes in our practices, technology, or applicable law.
  • The latest version will always be available on the website at https://gotoflow.io/privacy-policy.
  • We encourage you to review this policy periodically. Continued use of the Service after changes constitutes acceptance of the updated policy.

Contact
